description: This file contains unit tests for the JobTitleService class in the OrangeHRM project. It verifies functionality such as retrieving, deleting, and transforming job title data, utilizing mock objects and test data fixtures.

classes.name: JobTitleServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the JobTitleService functions, including fetching, deleting, and converting job title data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of JobTitleService and loading test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleList
methods.description: Tests that the service correctly retrieves a list of JobTitle objects from the DAO.

methods.name: testDeleteJobTitle
methods.description: Tests the deletion of specified job titles via the service and verifies the expected number of deletions.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleById
methods.description: Verifies that the service can retrieve a JobTitle object by its ID.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleArray
methods.description: Checks that the service correctly returns an array of job titles suitable for UI display.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleArrayForEmployee
methods.description: Ensures that the service provides job title data formatted correctly for an employee context.
